rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Osaki mamalia sangat kecil mirip rubah dengan satu ekor berbulu yang terbelah tepat di ujung.

visual_requirements.description: Mamalia kecil mirip rubah/musang dengan empat kaki, satu kepala dan ekor berbulu terbelah dua pada ujungnya.
Gerak sangat cepat saat menerjang dalam rumah; tidak ada pita energi atau aura.
Interior rumah manusia; wadah nasi dan tutup panci sebagai konteks kemunculan.

aura: Keganjilan ekor terbelah c08 dan gerak kilat c09 dalam framing dekat, tanpa memperbesar ukuran fisik.
artistic_choices: Kamera makro sangat rendah di permukaan papan; wadah nasi berukuran normal menunjukkan makhluk ini kecil.
Warna bulu gelap dan cahaya minyak hangat editorial. Tidak memvisualkan perasukan atau kekayaan; hanya gerak cepat terdokumentasi.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Osaki, a very small fox-like magical mammal of Japanese folklore.
ANATOMY: one small narrow fox-weasel head, two ears, two eyes, four small paws, one fluffy tail whose terminal tip divides clearly into TWO equally visible fluffy branches; the tail has one base only [osaki-c08].
MOMENT: lunging straight across a wooden floor toward the low camera, shoulders lowered, mouth open with tiny natural teeth, bristling and confrontational; both forked tail tips curl visibly above its back.
POWER: extremely fast movement made visible by thrown floor dust and swept fur, no magical glow [osaki-c09].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme macro ground-level close-up; tiny creature fills square through close distance, a normal rice container and pot lid behind are far larger than its whole body. Never a giant fox.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm household oil-lamp side light, deep shadows and rim light.
SURFACE: coarse dark walnut fur, fine whiskers, scuffed wooden floor.
SETTING: dim human home, plain rice container and a metal pot lid behind, the sound of which reveals osaki [osaki-c09, osaki-c16].
MOOD: uncanny, ferociously intense and dangerous at tiny scale, never cute or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: one tail base forked only at the final third, fork prominent at thumbnail size; no multiple separate tails, no horns, no extra heads or limbs; no text, logo, border or watermark; no borrowed entertainment design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic aura, luminous eyes, neon outline or energy ribbons.
